name: additional.R
content:
get_ip_address <- function() { os <- Sys.info()["sysname"] |> unname() if (os == "Windows") { ip <- system("ipconfig", intern = TRUE) |> iconv(from = "ISO-8859-1", to = "UTF-8") ip <- ip[grep("IPv4", ip)] ip <- sub(".*:\\s*([0-9\\.]+)", "\\1", ip) ip <- ip[1] } else if (os == "Linux") { ip_all <- system("ip addr", intern = TRUE) ip_lines <- ip_all[grep("inet ", ip_all)] ip_filtered <- ip_lines[!grepl("127\\.0\\.0\\.1", ip_lines)] ip <- sub(".*inet ([0-9\\.]+)/.*", "\\1", ip_filtered) ip <- ip[1] } else { stop("Unsupported OS") } return(ip) } result_desctiption_ref <- list( list("atk_val", "Attack roll: "), list("dmg_total", "
Damage total: "), list("dmg_mag", " ("), list("armor_pierce", "
Armor pierce: "), list("heal", "
Heal: "), list("move", "
Move: "), list("special_1", "
Special (symbols): "), list("special_2", "
Special (add set of symbols): "), list("special_burst", "
Special (burst): ") ) |> rbindlist() setnames(result_desctiption_ref, c("variable", "description")) result_desctiption_ref <- result_desctiption_ref[, sort_val := 1:.N] dice_ref <- list( list("purple", 1, "#5f4fa1", "#ffffff"), list("orange", 3, "#ea5f24", "#ffffff"), list("red", 5, "#992a49", "#ffffff"), list("grey", 7, "#53636c", "#ffffff"), list("sky", 9, "#23b6e6", "#ffffff"), list("brown", 11, "#6b3520", "#ffffff"), list("hunter", 13, "#007a4d", "#ffffff"), list("white", 2, "#ffffff", "#000000"), list("teal", 4, "#00b5aa", "#000000"), list("green", 6, "#8bc63f", "#000000"), list("blue", 8, "#0d59a9", "#000000"), list("fire", 10, "#f6a61c", "#000000"), list("yellow", 12, "#edec6d", "#000000"), list("pink", 14, "#f27798", "#000000") ) |> rbindlist() setnames(dice_ref, c("id", "conv_val", "color", "stroke")) dice_ref <- dice_ref[order(conv_val)] dice_all <- dice_ref[CJ(id = id, side = c(1:6), unique = TRUE), on = c("id")] dice_all <- dice_all[, value := side + (conv_val - 1) %/% 2 + 1] dice_all <- dice_all[conv_val %% 2 == 1 & side <= 3, value := value - 1] dice_all <- dice_all[conv_val %% 2 == 0, shields := (side - 1) %/% 2] dice_all <- dice_all[conv_val %% 2 == 0, books := (side - 1) %/% 3] dice_all <- dice_all[conv_val %% 2 == 1, shields := (side - 1) %/% 3] dice_all <- dice_all[conv_val %% 2 == 1, books := (side - 1) %/% 2] dice_all <- dice_all[, bursts := side %/% 6] empower_ref <- data.table( side = c(1,2,3,4,5,6), shields = c(0,1,2,3,4,0), books = c(4,3,2,1,0,0) ) modifiers_ref <- list( list("shield_1", 1, "shield", NA), list("book_1", 1, "book", NA), list("shield_2", 2, "shield", "shield"), list("book_2", 2, "book", "book"), list("shield_book", 2, "shield", "book") ) |> rbindlist() setnames(modifiers_ref, c("id", "elems", "elem_1", "elem_2")) calc_tutor_text <- paste0( "

How to use this app

", "

", "

    ", "
  1. ", "Press the 'Add tab' button", "
    2. ", "
  2. ", "Once a new tab appears at the top of the page, tap on it (it should be named 'tab_1')", "
    3. ", "
  3. ", "Tap on 'Main settings' to choose which dice you are using, as well as your symbol abilities", "
    4. ", "
  4. ", "Tap on 'Additional settings' to choose more situational modifiers, such as an additional set of symbol abilities, bonus damage while flanking, flat bonus damage, etc.", # "
    I recommend including there only your passive abilities, as it will be applied to every roll", "
    5. ", "
  5. ", "In the 'Roll' section, choose whether you are empowering the attack, have the courage effect, or are flanking the opponent", "
    6. ", "
  6. ", "Then, choose the result of the dice you rolled", "
    7. ", "
  7. ", "Check the 'Result' section to see how much damage the attack would deal", "
    8. ", "
", "

" ) other_stuff_text <- "

Other stuff

You can rename a tab in the 'Tab name' field at the top of the page.

The 'Game version' setting currently only affects the courage effect. In v1.1 it adds a burst; in v1.2 it does not.

All of the tabs you create are automatically saved and will be restored if you close or reload the page.

The app was designed with usage on mobile devices in mind. It should still be usable on a bigger screen, but it is advised to resize your window to more mobile-like proportions in that case.

This app does not aim to replace all calculations done during an attack, but rather to simplify the process (which is especially tedious if you make 7-10 attacks per turn). You will still need to subtract enemy's defence, armor, apply resistances, attack roll penalties, and effects on the enemy. All exhaust abilities are also up to you to add. However, it should still make your life a little bit easier.

"
